name: Illuga
notes: KQM and Game8 agree: 4pc Silken Moon's Serenade, EM on goblet and circlet, EM or ER sands, Burst first (both: Burst > Skill). Goals are Game8's: EM 750+ and ER 140-160 with Favonius Lance, 160-180 without (160 used); KQM's ER depends on the Geo teammate (Zibai, Navia, Itto, Noelle, Ningguang) from 125 to 210. CRIT Rate 40-50 is only wanted with Favonius Lance, so it is not a goal. Weapons differ in order: Game8's best is Favonius Lance, KQM lists Dragon's Bane first; Favonius Lance leads because it also fixes ER. His buffs and Lunar-Crystallize damage scale with EM (and DEF in his multipliers), so the scaling stat is EM. Partners are Geo characters (his Moonsign buff is for a Geo team).
